(2) The bootstrap package.json has react, react-dom, motion, lucide-react, vite, the react plugin, typescript, the @types packages, eslint and typescript-eslint, and playwright. (3) bootstrap.test.ts copies the bootstrap into a fresh mkdtemp directory, runs `npm ci`, lint and `npm run verify` (build plus render), and asserts PASS [build] and PASS [render]. A second case runs detect, apply and createPresentation on an empty temp directory and then verifies the result. This is the required materialize-and-build integration test. (4) Kit alignment: the canonical and bootstrap copies of Presentation.tsx, Stage.tsx, Footer.tsx and usePresentationNav.ts are identical. sync-template.mjs `copyKit` builds the snapshot from the canonical kit, and template.test.ts asserts that the file set and per-file hashes are identical. The other kit files were not supplied, so the byte-identity test and the sync script are what cover them. (5) Chromium: SKILL.md §3 directs the agent to run `npx playwright install chromium` when no Chromium is available. That is a conditional install instruction in the normative procedure, not only a statement that Chromium is required. dispute_checks{"demo-integration":[],"scene-kit":[],"presentation-skill":[],"verification-tooling":[],"engineering-quality":[{"id":"engineering-preview-terminated-on-every-exit","classification":"confirmed","rationale":"The requirement asks the scripts to &#39;terminate and await the preview server process itself on every exit path&#39;. The review guidance says the same: each exit path &#39;must terminate the preview server process itself and await its exit, or close a server started through Vite&#39;s preview() API&#39;. The material backs the auditor&#39;s account. In both preview.mjs copies, `stop()` is a synchronous `process.kill(-child.pid, &#39;SIGKILL&#39;)` inside a try/catch. It returns nothing that can be awaited, and nothing listens for the child&#39;s &#39;exit&#39; or &#39;close&#39; event. The finally blocks in verify.mjs and inspect-presentation.mjs, both repository and bootstrap copies, call `preview.stop()` without awaiting anything. The readiness-timeout path in startPreview also calls `stop()` without awaiting. The scripts don&#39;t use Vite&#39;s preview() API, so the alternative way to pass doesn&#39;t apply. Killing the whole process group does satisfy the &#39;terminate the server itself&#39; clause. The &#39;await its exit&#39; clause is still unmet in every copy, and the primary verdict admits this. The pass is defeated.","evidence":["scripts/lib/preview.mjs and the bootstrap copy: `const stop = () =&gt; { try { process.kill(-child.pid, &#39;SIGKILL&#39;) } catch { /* already gone */ } }`. The function is synchronous, and no liste…","scripts/verify.mjs and the bootstrap verify.mjs: `finally { await browser?.close(); preview.stop() }`. Nothing awaits the preview&#39;s exit","scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs and the bootstrap copy: `finally { await browser?.close(); preview.stop() }`. Nothing awaits the preview&#39;s exit","startPreview&#39;s readiness-failure path calls `stop()` and rethrows without awaiting the child&#39;s exit","The preview is spawned through process.execPath with vite.js rather than the preview() API, so the &#39;close a preview() server&#39; alternative does not apply"],"citations":["scripts/lib/preview.mjs","skills/presentation/templates/bootstrap/scripts/lib/preview.mjs","scripts/verify.mjs","skills/presentation/templates/bootstrap/scripts/verify.mjs","scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs","skills/presentation/templates/bootstrap/scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs"],"marker":"","stage":"contradiction-check","panel_index":1,"sample":2}],"testing-evidence":[],"assumption-handling":[]}
